subject: Coffee & Tea
title: How Coffee Plants Grow
description: A quick win: understand How Coffee Plants Grow.

hook.text: A coffee seedling takes three to four years before it produces its first cherries.

buildup.text: Coffee trees flower after rain. White, jasmine-scented blossoms cover the branches for just a few days.

discovery.text: Cherries take 9 months to ripen—green to yellow to red. Only ripe red cherries make great coffee.

twist.text: A single tree produces only 1–2 pounds of roasted coffee per year. Your morning cup needs a lot of trees.

climax.text: Trees fruit for 20–30 years. The best farms prune and replant in cycles to maintain quality and yield.

punchline.text: Four years to first fruit. One tree, two pounds a year.

quiz.question: How long does a coffee seedling take to produce fruit?

details.summary: Coffee plants are tropical evergreens that need specific conditions: shade, altitude, rainfall, and temperatures between 15 and 25 degrees Celsius. A plant takes three to five years to bear fruit. Arabica thrives at higher altitudes while robusta grows in lowland tropical regions.
details.whyItMatters: Coffee's strict growing requirements confine it to the tropical belt. Climate change is shrinking suitable growing area, threatening global supply.
takeaways: Coffee plants need 3 to 5 years before first harvest
Arabica grows best at 1000 to 2000 meters elevation
Climate change is reducing suitable coffee-growing land

faq.question: How long does a coffee plant live and produce?
faq.answer: A coffee plant can live 30 to 50 years but peak production occurs between years 7 and 20. After that, yields decline and farmers typically replace aging trees. Some wild coffee trees in Ethiopia are over 100 years old.

faq.question: Can coffee be grown outside the tropics?
faq.answer: Coffee needs consistent warmth and is frost-sensitive, limiting it to the band between the Tropics of Cancer and Capricorn. Experimental farms in California and southern Japan produce small quantities, but commercial production requires tropical conditions.
